# Farid A. Khavari, Ph.D. — Economist, Inventor & Author

> The official author site of Dr. Farid A. Khavari — Iranian-American economist, inventor, and author of the Zero Cost Economics series, Environomics, and Towards a Zero-Cost Economy. Born in Yazd, educated in Germany, at home in Miami since 1977. His system, Carefreeism: freeze, reduce, and eliminate unnecessary costs — no new taxes, same income — so the average family can retire wealthy. "Prosperity that costs nothing and pays forever."

## The idea — Zero Cost Economics / Carefreeism
- Diagnosis: costs of every kind keep rising and accelerating while incomes stagnate; over a working life, recurring costs (energy, housing, cars, insurance, health, education) consume what people earn.
- Method: policy changes that freeze, then reduce, then eliminate unnecessary costs. No new taxes; the same income goes dramatically further — a mortgage retired in 10 years instead of 30, electricity prepaid for years instead of a lifetime, insurance at half the cost.
- Elements: free abundant energy, zero-interest home financing, one universal insurance, preventive healthcare, free education from kindergarten through university, and "SuperJobs" — work whose product permanently lowers everyone's costs.

## Biography note
- Dr. Khavari formerly ran for Governor of Florida (2010 and 2014) and for Miami-Dade County Mayor (2016). Those campaigns are part of his biography and history; he is an author and economist, not a current candidate.
